newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skandia says likely to be in Nordic deal.
newsitem.headline: Skandia says likely to be in Nordic deal.

text.p: Swedish insurer Skandia said on Wednesday it was likely to take part in a structural deal in the Nordic region in the foreseeable future.
"The market is going to be restructured. We don't know if it will take three or five years," Skandia's chief executive Lars-Eric Petersson told a news conference.
"It will occur within a foreseeable period and I believe that Skandia will of course be a player in such a restructuring."
